claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-029
Date of Incident: March 11, 2021
Time of Incident: Approximately 1730 hours to 1815 hours
Location: Pacific Coast Highway and Newport Coast Drive, Laguna Beach, CA
Reporting Officer: Corporal V. Huang
Badge Number: 2744
Subject: Elliot Marsh, Male, approximately 30 years old, White, black sweatshirt, light blue t-shirt
Officer(s): Corporal V. Huang, Officer B. Nakamura, Sergeant L. Ferris
Witness(es): Vehicle collision victims (not interviewed at scene)
On March 11, 2021, at approximately 1730 hours, I was patrolling Pacific Coast Highway in my marked Laguna Beach Police Department unit
I received a dispatch advisory regarding a stolen white Mercedes sedan last seen heading southbound on Pacific Coast Highway
The vehicle had been reported stolen approximately 30 minutes earlier
I located the Mercedes at approximately 1735 hours and initiated a traffic stop
Upon activating my emergency lights, the subject initially slowed and pulled onto the shoulder of Pacific Coast Highway
I exited my vehicle and approached on the driver's side
Before I could make contact, the subject accelerated away, heading southbound
I immediately returned to my patrol vehicle to pursue
Shortly after the pursuit began, Laguna Beach officers deployed a spike strip, which deflated the Mercedes' tires
The subject continued to flee despite the tire damage
The pursuit lasted approximately 45 minutes
The subject drove at speeds exceeding 90 miles per hour
The subject drove erratically but did not collide with any other vehicles
An Orange County Sheriff helicopter joined the pursuit and provided aerial tracking
Officer Nakamura executed a PIT maneuver, bringing the Mercedes to a stop in the southbound lane of Pacific Coast Highway
Three patrol units converged on the stopped vehicle, positioning approximately 15 feet away with takedown lights illuminated
The subject remained in the vehicle for roughly two minutes
The subject exited from the driver's side door
The subject initially stood still with his arms at his sides
I gave repeated verbal commands for the subject to get on the ground
The subject slowly began walking toward the officers
The subject raised both hands chest-high with palms pressed together and fingers extended, pointing directly at Officer Nakamura in a motion that simulated aiming a firearm
I discharged my firearm, firing six rounds at the subject at approximately 1812 hours
The entire engagement from the subject exiting the vehicle to my firing lasted approximately 15 seconds
After the shots were fired, the subject dropped to the ground immediately
I approached with Sergeant Ferris and placed the subject in handcuffs
We began rendering first aid
Laguna Beach Fire Department paramedics arrived within approximately five minutes
and transported the subject to a nearby hospital
the subject was treated for two gunshot wounds to the torso
The subject survived his injuries
Subject transported to hospital for emergency treatment
Subject survived
Scene secured for OCDA investigation
Body-worn camera footage (Corporal Huang, Officer Nakamura, Sergeant Ferris)
Patrol vehicle video recordings
Six (6) cartridge casings, 9mm
One (1) black Taser X26 and one (1) Taser cartridge
Clothing items from the subject
Scene photographs
